description: This file defines a Drupal behavior for accessibility announcements, creating an aria-live region and a debounced announce function for screen reader notifications.

methods.name: Drupal.behaviors.drupalAnnounce.attach
methods.description: Creates and appends an aria-live region to the DOM if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: announce
methods.description: Concatenates queued announcements and updates the aria-live region to trigger screen reader notifications.

methods.name: Drupal.announce
methods.description: Queues a message for announcement and returns a debounced call to the announce function.
